S.FORM: == kakiliman == tuud kazizeng, tabakiay nu mitupinay tu tuud a tulaku u tulaku han a pangangan, angangan u miculu'ay tu tuud a kazizeng anca dingkiay a kazizeng, amililid tu zuma a kazizeng, tungus kasizuma nu misiwbayay a kazizeng. zuma miduduc tu baeket a pasizuma tu baketay atu ahemaway a kazizengn i lunuk kazizeng ayaw caaynay kadengdeng, mitupinay tu tuud a kazizeng baketay sepatay ku behel a kazizeng pangangan han tu subayu kazizeng Wagon. itawyaay a zizay hatu u mitupinay tu tuud a kazizeng u nihakaan ku cayay palawpes tu simal u ca-yu ingzing ku sapihaka, nika ahemaway nu mitupinay a kazizeng micukaymas tu simal, gasu, anca gasuay a simal a zayliw, 2010 a mihcaan izaw tu ku misiwbayay a kusi milungad tu simal dingkiay papulung tu pisaungay atu batiliay a mitupinay tu tuud a tulaku, nika caay henay kayadah ku nisanga'an a pacakay. mitengtengay kazizeng 全拖車 zuma tuud kazizeng anca u tangah nu kazieng pacait tu sapad anca sapitengteng, nipacait zikuz a kazizeng maliyuc tu pangkiw a patabaki, zikuz nu paculilan mapatabaki ku lalimucu', kyu zuma a kitizaan pala u micidekay a kazizeng "patinaku, Aw-cow zazan nu kazizeng". i Cong-kow-talu, hamin nu tengtengay a kazizeng u mitengtengay a kazizeng" han a pangangan, mitengtengan a kazizeng sakaput a kazizeng u zazan nu kazizeng, Taywan nu matatulesay a kazizeng han a pangangan. . balas kazizeng 砂石車 balas kazizeng, pangangan han tu suwa taw cya han, Cong-kow-talu ca-se kazizeng han, u kay-tau tuud kazizeng han, angangan u sapiculu' tu balas atu kanaayan a zaylyaw nu sakakawawan, u sapiculu' tu sikitang, ba'tu. lamakung a kazizeng, zuma kitizaan canlye kazizeng han, u sapatayza tu amutu tuud kazizeng, tanengay a maniyul mikiwakiw tu amutu a singangan. . matahpuay tuud kazizeng 密斗貨車 matahpuay tuud kazizeng, Cong-kow-talu pangangan han tu "sihakuay a kazizeng' caay kalecad tu hu-kuy, matahpuay a kazizeng caay kalaliyas ku sidama'ay a kazizeng atu tuwcya tangah. cacay u matahpuay a kazizeng, taneng a pasazumaen kuyni, isasa nu tulaku atu tangah nu kazizeng "ngangan nu Kang, cya-can atu tangah nu kazizeng" cacay mitupina tu tuud nu sihakuay, cacay sapatapabaw a sapad "pangangan han nu Sya-kang kikul sapad". hu-kuy a kazizeng, mazeting kuyza matineng tu aw sapiculu' tu hu-kuy a kazizeng. hu-kuay a kazizeng, taneng palatuluen, mitengtengay a kazizeng "pangangan han nu Sya-kang sisatengtenganay" mitengtengay a kazizeng "pangangan nu Sya-kang u mitengtengan tu kazizedng" a hu-kuy, hu-kuy kazizeng a kung-tun iza ku 35 kung-tun " 20 ing-ce ku hu-kuy" atu 43 kung-tun "40/45 ing depah ku hu-kuy". sapaday tulaku, singangan aca tu tulaku, u tabakiay nu mitupinay tu baketay a tuud a tulaku. i ayzaay nisanga' tu tabakiay anca hinaazihay tu sakawawan. ayza katuud ku micukaymas tu canacanan a tuudan miculu' tu cayay kabatan a zazan. u sapiselep tu sapiculu' a kalisiw, pakalamkam tu sakakawawan, mikyezey' tu nikawaw a demiad a kapah ku nikawaw. taneng pacait i likut, micunus tu sapicukaymas. simal, u maka labuay nu lala' a simal nihudhudan anca palasawaden, misaadidi' tahkal a icelang, u taneng a matuduhay a cinan pacamul han tu nanumay, taneng sapilikat a zaylyaw. mapangangan i Sang-kang u simal "dingki" han. simal u nayay ku kulit a nanum "caluway amahapinang caay kalecad ku sin-wan-ceay a simal, uzuma pacumuden ku zumaay a kulit", micidek ku sanek. madayum m alabali, madayum malikat. angangan C5～C12 ku simal tin atu kasasuma a hown-tin, adidi' ku bangsis tin atu liw-huw-u. sapicukaymas sapilikat a simal i labu nu kikay, kanca i pipenec caay ka lunuk sa matuduh. u icelang nu simal miduduc tu kayadah nu sin-wan. cunus tu simal sin-wanay zuma pacumuden ku se-i-ci-cyen, nika sikala'cus nu uzip, saaca mapeci' ku sakuwan tu sapatahkal tu mauningay mitiyung tu sapaniyul, , namahiza 1980 a mihcaan malingatu u-cyen a simal haymaw satu makutay nu yu-cyen simal "nipangangan "kaw-ci simal", ayza simal tu nu hikuki dada'", nu zuma malumanay a ingzing hakay cukaymasen caay henay kaicelang micumud ku bali panan nu aenengan, anu u-cyen simal dada' ku cukaymasan amatabal mapeci', mahiniay a ingzing kapah amkicukaymas tu u-cyen a siamal, nika alahican pacunusen tu kutay a cyen-ci. 因此1980 . katukuh 2011 a mihcaan, hamin nu kitakit izaw tu ku A-bu-han, A-al atu Li-ya,I-la-ke, Caw-syen, Mey-tyen atu Ye-men enem a kanatal ku micukaymasay henay tu yu-cyen a simal, kapulung a kanatal atu uyni enemay a kanatal makakadum paketun tu sapialesd tu yu-cyen simal a kawaw, taneng i 2013 a mihcaan hamin a kitakit acaay tu picukaymas tu yu-cyen sima. 2021 a nihca 8 a bulad 30 a demiad, kapulung a kanatal makakadum tu enemay a kanatal milekakawa tu hekal pakatineng i kitakit nu sazikuzay pawapenay tu yu-cyen simal a kanatal A-al-ci- li-ya i 7 a bulad malingatu pasatezep a pawapen, u tatenga'ay tu malikisi ku yu-cyen simal. 至2011年, . Taywan 臺灣 ai-sin-cen "simal, sumamad zayhan u al-sin-cen inzing a kazizedng atu sakikayan "mahiniay sapibelisiw, salutalut" namicukaymas a malungad, angangan sikaw-ci simal atu 3~5% ku ai-sin-cen simal, zikuz sumadan tu u-ci-yen simal palamelen tu al-sin-cen simal a pacakay. Kitizaay a apacakay haymaw satu malelul, ayaw nu i 2006 a mihca 4 a bulad 25 a demiad tatenga'ay tu misatezep pacakay, ayaw a misatezep pacakay sazikuzay a aca pay-kungh-sen 28 ku kalisiw nu Taywan, imahini mahamin tu mapacakay. kaw-ci simal, u cayay ku kalawlaway, kasumamadan u zse-i-ci-cyen malau u sapitena' amatuduh, u icelang pakala macapi tu 92-95. tini i 2000 a mihca 1 abulad 1 a demiad malingatu masatezep a pacakay, misabalucu' tu malumanay pakutay tu 95 u-ci-yen, saayaway tahkal nu kusiay nu balakiay tu a kazizeng maydih pacunus mikutay tu cyen-ci. 92 u-cyen simal, u sumilaway, zuma sapicukaymas i singzing tu apuyu'ay a akazizeng, nika zuma baluhay a kazizeng kapah tu a cukaymasan caay tu kamakuhac, kapah tu ku nikatuduh. 95 u-cyen simal, kulawlawan, nu Taywan a simalan nu satabakiay simalan, matatungus tu i zazanay nu muculilay a kazizeng atu hamin i Taywan nu pacakayay tu kazizeng tu simalay a kazizeng. 95 + u-cyen simal, Tay-su batuay nu tekeday a tuud tu misiwbayay, sin-wan a aca pakal tu ~96, Tay-su batuay i 2015 a mihca 6 a bulad 24 a demiad malunga'tu misanga' pacakay, mikutay tu Tay-su 95 u-cyen simal. 95 u-cyen simal. u kasumanamanahan, tatungu i talakawaay a inzing ku kasukut, u tineng wayway u sakapahay nipacumud a kazizengan. nika i pisumadan tu kazizengan zuma nisumad tu ci-kang cunusan tuyni a simal a kapah ku kazizeng. E3 alikulu simal, nu cong-yu I 2007 a mihcaan malingatu patatungus tu ce-bu micuduh pakutay palekal tu sasimalan, nipawapenan tu u-cyen simalan pacamul tu 3% alikulu, nipanutek amiwada' tu malecaday a tuduh nu simal tu nipatahkal tu tan. Alikulu talakaw ku sin-wan-ce talakaw ku yeng, matuduh taneng makelul ku kamakuhac, belat nu lamal atu likat a lamal pitalakawan ku simal a lihalay supeden ku tadesimal. kanahatu alikulu a akuti' kikalacusan tu simal, nika uyza E3 kapah ku katuduh, palalecad tu tusaay kakapah nu ingzing atu malecad tu ku nipalawpes tu simal. atatungu tu kazized nngan pisabalucu' mipalita tu misangaay tu kazizeng a kusi.
